name: Shapes and Sides
description: Eight picture questions about flat shapes: their sides, corners and names.
author: Lullshift

help.summary: Eight multiple-choice questions about flat shapes, each with a simple picture, shown on Quick Quiz.
help.goal: Just for fun. Answer a few or all eight; your score is shown only to you.
howToPlay: Look at the picture, or read its description, and choose an answer.
You will see the right answer and a short explanation.
Press Next question to carry on, or stop whenever you like.
At the end, Play again gives a fresh shuffle.
tips: Every picture has a description that screen readers announce, so each question can be answered without seeing it.
